elements.requirement: Statutory rules on secondary contracts apply if a term of a contract (“the secondary contract”) reduces the rights or remedies or increases the obligations of a person under another contract (“the main contract”).
elements.quote: reduces the rights or remedies or increases the obligations of a person under another contract (“the main contract”)

elements.requirement: A term of a secondary contract that alters rights, remedies, or obligations under a main contract is subject to the provisions of this Part that would apply to the term if it were in the main contract.
elements.quote: The term is subject to the provisions of this Part that would apply to the term if it were in the main contract.

elements.requirement: The rules governing a term of a secondary contract apply regardless of whether the parties to the secondary contract are the same as the parties to the main contract.
elements.quote: whether the parties to the secondary contract are the same as the parties to the main contract

elements.requirement: The rules governing a term of a secondary contract apply regardless of whether the secondary contract is a consumer contract.
elements.quote: whether the secondary contract is a consumer contract

elements.requirement: The statutory rules on secondary contracts do not apply if the secondary contract is a settlement of a claim arising under the main contract.
elements.quote: the secondary contract is a settlement of a claim arising under the main contract
